mxCell.value: WorldGrid Spatial manager that owns chunk cache, routes queries through GridPoints, and keeps runtime Assets bound to the grid so updating and rendering can find entities quickly.
chunks_ Map keyed by chunk coordinates holding the active chunk state used to load, unload, and query regions.
points_ Dense GridPoint array covering the same world span so WorldGrid can answer which assets occupy every coordinate.
Chunk Block of GridPoints plus tile and asset metadata used to stream localized sections of the world.
tiles Chunk keeps its GridTile definitions here to describe the geometry and lighting of each cell.
assets Chunk stores the runtime Assets inside its bounds to batch updates, residency checks, and unloading.
GridTile Static tile descriptor that captures bounds, textures, and lighting for a single grid cell.
world_rect World-space rectangle used to determine whether the tile sits inside the camera bounds.
texture Light texture overlay object that paints the tile illumination and blends with the base color.
GridPoint Shared cell structure that holds world/chunk coordinates, render offsets, and references to occupying Assets.
id Unique handle for each GridPoint so residency and caching layers can reference it directly.
grid_index Flat index inside the overall grid array so lookups can be performed with a single pointer.
chunk_index Index linking the point back to its owning chunk for chunk-level invalidation or streaming.
world World-space coordinate pair that locates this GridPoint inside the scene.
chunk Chunk identifier or pointer letting the GridPoint know which chunk contains it.
screen Latest screen-space data used by the renderer to draw assets anchored to this grid point.
parallax_dx Horizontal offset used to nudge assets for parallax layers when the camera moves.
tilt_radians Tilt value applied when simulating perspective so the point distorts correctly.
perspective_scale Scale factor used to shrink or enlarge attached assets based on distance or perspective.
horizon_fade_alpha Alpha value applied when the point nears the horizon to fade assets gracefully.
distance_to_camera Cached distance metric so rendering and shading can adjust level of detail.
vertical_scale Vertical stretch factor that adjusts assets when the camera tilts up or down.
on_screen Flag indicating whether the cell is inside the camera view.
screen_data_frame_updated Frame counter noting if the screen layout data has been recomputed this update.
screen_data_valid Boolean that confirms the cached screen data can be used instead of forcing a rebuild.
Asset Runtime object that carries position, animation, render caches, controller, and child references so the engine can update and draw it.
spawn_fields Spawn metadata that tells the asset what slots or triggers to use when it is instantiated.
pointer_fields Pointers the asset keeps to controllers, timers, or external references required during updates.
state_fields Stateful data such as flags, counters, or timers that tracks what the asset is doing currently.
cached_grid_residency_ Cache of the set of grid points and chunks the asset has touched for quicker residency checks.
smoothing_states Smoothing data used to interpolate motion or state transitions across frames.
anim_runtime_ Runtime animation data that tracks which animation is playing and its progress.
current_frame Pointer to the animation frame currently displayed for this asset.
frame_progress Progress metric between animation frames used to interpolate motion.
animation_children_ List of animation-driven child attachments that follow the parent asset.
render_package Prepared render resources such as textures, masks, and geometry that the renderer pulls per frame.
mask_render_metadata_ Metadata for mask drawing so shadow and lighting passes can reuse computed masks.
tiling_info_ Info about how this asset tiles across the grid, including origins and coverage.
shadow_mask_cache_ Cached shadow textures this asset uses when lighting or occlusion conditions remain stable.
cast_shadow_cache_ Cache of the shadow silhouettes cast by the asset for reuse by the light system.
asset_children Explicit child asset instances owned by this asset for layered graphics or composite entities.
controller_ Reference to the controller that drives input, AI, or scripted behavior for the asset.
neighbors Nearby GridPoint handles the asset can query for collision, pathing, or spread effects.
impassable_neighbors Subset of neighbors that block traversal so movement logic can respect obstacles.
angle_from_camera Angular difference between the camera and the asset used to tweak shading or occlusion.
last_scale_usage_ Cache of the last scale pulled from AssetInfo so the asset knows when to refresh visuals.
scale_variant_state_ Current scale variant applied to the asset, guiding which textures or transforms to use.
grid_id_ Identifier tying the asset back to the grid cell for quick residency lookups.
anim_ Reference to the current animation definition the asset is playing.
AnimationChildAttachment Links child assets to their parent with offsets and timing information for animation-driven setups.
child_index Index identifying which attachment slot this child occupies.
asset_name Name of the child asset that will be spawned or controlled.
animation_ref Pointer to the animation resource the child should follow.
current_frame_ref Reference to the child current frame so it stays in sync with the parent.
world_pos World-space offset applied when the child is attached to the parent.
visible Flag indicating whether the child should be rendered.
spawned_asset Runtime asset handle representing the actual spawned child.
timeline Timing data that dictates when the child appears, disappears, or updates.
RenderObject Structure produced by the Asset before handing data to the renderer, capturing geometry, masks, and blend settings.
screen_rect Screen-space rectangle used for clipping and visibility checks.
color_mod Color tint applied to the rendered object.
blend_mode Blend mode controlling how the object composites with others.
last_mask_texture Most recent mask texture so the renderer can reuse it until inputs change.
mask_defaults Fallback mask parameters used when the asset does not provide a custom mask.
base_defaults Default rendering settings used until richer data becomes available.
TilingInfo Data describing how tiling is laid out so assets can snap to the grid.
grid_origin Origin coordinate for the tiling pattern.
tile_size Dimensions used when tiling textures or aligning assets.
coverage Coverage ratios describing how much of the grid is filled.
anchor Anchor point used when aligning tiles to a grid origin.
AssetInfo Data record describing asset animations, tags, lighting, and spawn rules so the runtime can configure each Asset.
animations List of available Animation definitions for this AssetInfo.
animation_children Child definitions that follow specific animations.
async_children Definitions for children that start or stop asynchronously.
scale_factor Base scale applied to Assets using this info when no variant overrides exist.
smooth_scaling Flag enabling interpolation whenever the asset scale changes.
scale_variants Alternative scale bundles the runtime can swap in for different contexts.
tillable Flag that indicates whether the asset can tile horizontally or vertically.
z_threshold Threshold controlling when the asset renders in front or behind other elements.
flipable Flag that marks whether the asset can flip horizontally.
apply_distance_scaling Enables automatic scaling based on distance to the camera.
apply_vertical_scaling Enables scaling adjustments driven by vertical offsets.
is_shaded Controls whether the AssetInfo participates in shading passes.
shadow_mask_settings Settings that configure how this asset casts or receives shadow masks.
shading_parallax_amount Parallax multiplier used during shading to create depth.
shading_screen_brightness_multiplier Brightness multiplier applied to the screen-space shading result.
shading_opacity_multiplier Opacity multiplier that darkens or lightens shading overlays.
light_sources Local light sources tied to the asset for self-illumination or effects.
name Canonical name used for lookups and tooling.
type General type or category tag that drives logic branches.
custom_controller_key Key that maps to custom controller collections.
tags Positive tags used to find this AssetInfo when spawning or filtering content.
anti_tags Negative tags preventing this asset from appearing in incompatible contexts.
areas Named areas where this asset can spawn or operate.
preview_texture Texture used in editors or previews to represent the asset.
Animation Defines a sequence of frames and optional audio that assets can play.
frames Ordered AnimationFrame entries the runtime cycles through.
audio_data Attached audio cues that play when the animation is active.
source Source data or file path that contains the animation frames.
frame_cache_ Cache structure storing rendered frames for reuse.
AnimationFrame Single frame definition within an animation, including variants and child data.
variants List of variant textures or geometry for this frame.
hit_geometry Geometry used for hit detection while this frame is playing.
attack_geometry Geometry marking where attacks or damage should originate from.
children Child frame or asset definitions that activate during this frame.
FrameVariant Variant package that swaps textures, masks, and paths per animation frame.
varient Identifier used to choose this variant set.
base_texture Primary texture for this variant.
foreground_texture Foreground overlay texture applied while this variant is active.
background_texture Background overlay texture applied while this variant is active.
shadow_mask_texture Shadow mask texture used for the variant.
path Path or asset identifier where the variant textures come from.
volume Volume level for any sound tied to this variant.
kind Category or intent label for this variant such as idle or attack.
FrameCache Stores rendered textures for animation frames so they can be reused without re-creating GPU resources.
textures Cached textures for the frame cache.
foreground_textures Cached foreground overlays.
background_textures Cached background overlays.
mask_textures Cached mask textures used during shading.
AsyncChildDefinition Definition for a child asset that activates asynchronously.
asset AssetInfo reference that describes the async child.
animation Animation reference the async child will play.
ChildInfo Details describing how a child asset should align or offset.
area_name Name of the area the child should remain in.
z_offset Vertical offset applied while rendering the child.
spawn_group Spawn configuration block controlling how groups of assets spread across the map.
expansion_ratio Ratio the group uses to grow spawn radius as assets spawn.
blur_scale Softness factor controlling how the spawn group distributes assets.
falloff_start Distance where spawn density begins to taper.
falloff_exponent Exponent applied to sharpen or flatten density falloff.
alpha_multiplier Multiplier applied to spawn opacity or strength.
LightSource Light definition used to shade assets and grid points.
intensity Brightness value of the light.
radius Radius over which the light affects assets.
fall_off Curve value describing how the light dims with distance.
color RGB color of the light.
flicker_speed Speed at which the light twinkles or flickers.
in_front Flag saying whether the light renders in front of geometry.
render_to_dark_mask Flag indicating whether this light writes to the darkness mask.
NamedArea Named region that spawn data or animations can reference.
area Geometry or tag that defines the named region.
render_frame Render frame used for previewing the area.
RENDERER Visual label denoting the renderer section of the diagram.
Background color Label that highlights where the renderer background color is controlled.
